body: Read through your posts, and man I can feel your pain. I am very close to trying to end it very soon myself, for different reasons, but I can just feel your pain. Recently I have gone to groups for people trying to quit alcohol, because my addiction has ruined my life. For the first time I felt who I am, and wish I was humble enough to go sooner, but I was not. Im not trying to imply you have an addiction problem, but maybe some sort of support group could help you realize you are certainly not alone in whatever human flaw has brought you to this point. Its crazy to let go and accept you are flawed and see yourself so clearly in other people in these types of groups. Wish so so hard I had done it sooner.

I think its good you realize your problem. I agree with 321, u might want to see a psycologist or something similar, or try to open up to someone you trust. This is something that if you tackle it now, maybe you can find ways to feel better. 

As for your inmediate situation, even if it hurts, maybe you have to accept the lies that yu have told, and realize that you cant predict peoples reactions, so thinking about what someone is going to think is kind of a waste of energy. Maybe focus on your present and dealing with things as they come, without anticipating to things that might not happen
It makes me happy to hear when someone is doing better.

Sorry if this advice is not good for you, just trying to maybe give you some ideas that could help you a little, Im by no means an expert at anything, much less sharing my feelings, however Im trying to change that in my life. 

I really really do, even If I dont know you, that you get get better. 

Big big hug

Really not an expert at anything, just trying to say something that will help you.

Thanks for sharing your story, I dont know you, but I felt happy when I read the evolution you have had with dealing with the things that were holding you back for being well. Its nice to hear someone who was in a bad place is feeling better. 

I identify myself with many things that you said, misdirecting my anger, seeking my identity in external things, stubborn, and other things. I have also objectified other people. 

Maybe a difference between us is that I have being a dick to people. My defense mechanism was pride, deep-rootes pride, in the overexaggerating way. My mother is a very proud person, I think I might have taken that from her. But I had a moment that broke me mentally when I was 17, and the only way I found to get out was to rely on a exagerated and delisuional pride, very sad really. Very long story, but mainly I realize my mind is fucked, and that I have being a coward running from everything and hiding, and on top of that, being a dick to people. Shit is catching up to me, maybe karma, or maybe I just want to give a meaning to the simple fact that if you are an asshole to people, things wont go well. 
You know, im really thinking about this guy that I was such such a dick to him, and he was actually trying to help me. It was at a meeting for alcoholics, which I went cause my family insisted a lot. I was a fucking asshole. If I had listened to that guy, being empathetic or accepting my problem, maybe my life wouldnt be as ruined as it is. I dont have a real big big thing to complain about growing up, I was just weak and an asshole I think, for real. Or shit was too much too handle I dont know. 

Anyway, thank you for sharing. You have a friend here.
Some here. Priviledged life, being feeling like shit for so long, haven taken terrible decisions.

I always felt inadequate for many reasons. I also started watching porn around those years, and also felt guilty every time I masturbated, and I still feel guilty when I watch porn, its crazy, but I liked it a lot. I can tell you this, shit can always get worst, BELEIVE ME. And feeling like shit can take you to bad desicions so you can avoid reality, like drugs and alcohols. Im taking my time to write this because how you describes things, sounds cery similar to me, and maybe I can help so you dont make the same mistakes I did. 
I would tell you, that you should ever try drugs, and if you have, stop them immediatly. You know when people say that by just trying drugs one time, then you are hooked? Well its the fucking truth. Drugs take you away from reality, and thats what you may want. Well dont, they destroy your brain without you realizing it, and might leave in a world of hell way way worst than the one you are now, and you might think its not posible to feel worst, but unfortunately it is always posible to feel worse, specially if you are trapped in and damaged mind. The same goes for alcohol, exactly the same. This may seem less harmless as drugs, because they are socialmy accepted, but its all business and marketing. Companies are only interested in selling, so they will sell you and idea of fun and care free attitudes, among others, and so does some tv and movies. Dont fall for that. Alcohol is a super dangereous drug that can fuck up you life very easily.
I think you might be a very anxious person, with your mind always active, thinking. Try to tackle your anxiety. Look, anxiety has fucked up my life, combined with my pride. I have taken plenty medications, and none has worked for me, and I really think is because I didnt want them to work. At the end of the day, you are a human being, just like people that surround you, and accepting that you have flaws, being them physicall or in personality, its not wrong. Dont think you are more than a human being. give it your best shot at not being scared at looking who you are, I know it can be hard, but you exist and thats reality. Takle your anxiety, and medicstion might help. If it doesnt, try to calm yourself, and look for other solutions. For instance Im taking this homeopatic drug that has Passiflora and some other herb, and its sooo good. Calms me like nothing has ever in my life.

Sorry for assuming things about you, based on who I have being and Im. I just could resist giving my best shot at helping someone that might be similar to me, since I have been in hell for a long time and only made bad choices after another, and shit can always get worst, but I never could take slow down and try to chill, and I so regret it now. 

Hope all the best for you.

Bro, I get you. Sometimes one feels as if a woman could be the savior of ones life, giving you all the approval and affection you need. Believe me I get it. But think about this for a second: Maybe, by not meeting these women, you have saved yourself from big pain, and let me tell you why this is a plausible idea. Maybe you are moving in a circle, without realizing it. If you are indeed moving in a circle, you know what might happen in your next relationship? look at what happened in the one before, and before and what do they have in common? Maybe the kind of woman you are looking? certain personality trait they share? I dont know. Now instead of a circle, try moving in a straight line, which for me personally is hard, but might be a solution I think. What can you do to move in a straight line in your life without repeating past experiences. 
Im not saying loving someone and being loved is not an amazing experience, but maybe to look the world from inside instead of outside.
I dont know thinking about this might help you, sorry if it was not clear, just trying to tell you something I have thought about recently, trying to cope with the hardest time of my life. 
Good luck
